messages:
tess: Hey team — quick copy pass for the "Pin model version" confirmation modal. Want short, clear, and explain impact (routing, cost, overrides). Drafts below.

tess: Draft A:
`Pin version {{version}}? This routes traffic to the selected model version until unpinned. Pinning can affect cost and latency. Pin · Cancel`

omar: I like concise. But "affect cost and latency" is vague. Suggest: "may change cost and latency" and add note about rollout behavior: immediate vs gradual.

lee: Product: we need to call out that pinning overrides traffic routing policies (canary/autoscale). Maybe: "This overrides routing policies and sends all traffic to the pinned version." That's strong but accurate.

nora: Usability: avoid all-caps or scary words. How about softer: "Pinning will route traffic to this version and override automatic routing rules." Also add a link to rollout docs in the modal.

tess: New try:
`Pin version {{version}}? Pinning routes traffic to this version and overrides automatic routing rules. You may see different costs or latency. Learn more · Cancel · Pin`

omar: Suggest swap CTA order: Cancel (left), Pin (right, primary). Also change "You may see different costs or latency" -> "This may change cost and latency for your requests." More direct.

lee: Accessibility: add a short helper text under the title: "You can unpin to resume automatic routing." That helps recovery anxiety. Also ensure modal role=dialog and focus moves to it.

nora: For localization avoid contractions and keep placeholders for version name. Translation key suggestions: `pin.modal.title`, `pin.modal.body`, `pin.modal.helper`, `pin.modal.pin_cta`. Provide fallback english strings.
tess: Final proposed copy for PR:
- Title: `Pin model version`
- Body: `Pin version {{version}}? Pinning routes traffic to this version and overrides automatic routing rules. This may change cost and latency for your requests.`
- Helper: `You can unpin later to resume automatic routing.`
- Buttons: `Cancel` (secondary), `Pin version` (primary)
- Link: `Learn more` -> rollout docs (open in new tab)

omar: Also include a small checkbox option for teams who want a staged pin: `Start with gradual rollout (10%)` — if checked, CTA becomes `Pin and start gradual rollout`. But keep checkbox hidden by default and shown via "advanced" toggle.

lee: QA/eng note: include API payload fields: `pin=true|false`, `pin.mode=immediate|gradual`, `pin.initial_percent=0-100`. Add telemetry: `ui.pin.confirmed=true`.

nora: i18n-bot: Reminder: keep body under 140 chars where possible and provide context notes: "Shown when a user pins a model version from the console". Also avoid punctuation-heavy sentences.
tess: Accessibility checklist to include in ticket: role=dialog, aria-labelledby for title, body announced with aria-describedby, helper text linked, focus trap, primary CTA accessible via Enter, link has descriptive text for screen readers.

omar: One more microcopy nit: in helper text change "unpin" to "remove pin"? Which maps better to UI verb? Our action is "Unpin" in the dropdown. Keep consistency: use "unpin."

tess: Done. I'll update Figma, add translation keys and the optional gradual rollout checkbox to the spec, and include the accessibility items in the PR description. Thanks!
